messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: [P1] Dedicated pool 'auralabs-prod-vpc' GPU pressure. Tenant 'Aurora Labs' consuming ~98% of pool capacity -> risk of failed requests / evictions. Link: https://redwood/internal/incidents/7832104567 :rotating_light: On-call: @alice_ops

alice_ops: Taking this — joining the call. grabbing metrics now.

sanjay_r: Looking at tenant traffic: large spike of long-context jobs (>=8k tokens). Queue depth at 420, avg token latency ~800ms. Pool is 8 GPUs, 7 in use right now.

ben_cs: CS on call — pinged Aurora account owner (Marco). He says a nightly enrichment job was mistakenly pointed at prod. He confirms it's their job and asks for immediate mitigation.

mei_l: We have two immediate levers: 1) enable per-tenant burst from shared burst pool (2 GPUs available) or 2) evict low-priority tenants to free GPU(s). Burst is faster but billable.

adrian_p: +1 for burst + soft throttles. Also enable model length cap or prefix KV-caching to reduce repeated compute. Autoscaler will take too long to add more dedicated infra.

alice_ops: Proposal: approve burst of 2 GPUs for 45m, apply a temporary rate-limit (10rps per client) and cap sequences to 4096 tokens. Anyone object? Need CS confirmation to proceed. :hourglass_flowing_sand: 

ryan_eng: I can run the burst command. CLI: ``/infra burst-assign --tenant aurora --gpus 2 --duration 45m``. Will wait for CS ack.

ben_cs: Marco from Aurora approves temporary burst; asks to minimize impact and notify when done. I've opened a PM with him.

sanjay_r: Quick ask: can we evict internal non-critical tenant 'test-gateway' to free 1 GPU without impacting external customers? That'd reduce billing.

alice_ops: Prefer not to evict customer workloads. We'll go with burst + throttles. Ryan, please execute and then apply the routing rule. I'll monitor.

ryan_eng: Executing now: ``/infra burst-assign --tenant aurora --gpus 2 --duration 45m``
ryan_eng: Response: success -> burst-id b-7832. Pool logical capacity now shows 10 GPUs (2 burst). Effective usage: 9/10 GPUs. Queue depth dropped to ~120.

incident-bot: Incident update: burst applied (b-7832). Monitor window started. Next auto-check in 5m. Alerts throttled to on-call only.

mei_l: Applying middleware config for route 'aurora/*':
```
rate_limit: 10rps
max_input_tokens: 4096
enable_kv_prefix_cache: true
```
Deployed these rules to the gateway.

alice_ops: After changes: avg latency ~320ms, queue depth 45. Looks like throttles + burst helped. Will keep monitoring for 45m. Auto-escalate if queue >200 or error rate >3%.

ben_cs: Ticket INC-7832 created with communication log and CS action items. Marco notified.

sanjay_r: Post-incident actions (prelim): 1) Tenant job gating (prevent prod-targeted scheduled jobs), 2) Burst budget guardrails + alerts, 3) Recommend client-side request size caps. I'll draft a runbook entry.

alice_ops: If stable at end of 45m we'll release burst and revert rate-limit. Creating follow-up task: "aurora-burst-7832104567" assigned to alice_ops.

ryan_eng: Monitoring in background. :thumbsup: Will post when burst ends or if issues surface.

alice_ops: Thanks team — leaving watch on for 45m. I'll update incident page and close thread updates unless something changes.
